verdict.rationale: Cal.com's own docs directly state the exact value proposition: 'Share a booking link, connect your calendars, and let people pick a time without the back-and-forth,' backed by API/product features like available-slots lookup, event types, and scheduling configuration that make this work, and community feedback confirms real-world usage replacing manual scheduling (e.g. switching from Calendly due to UX). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the live-availability booking flow itself (most corroboration is docs-based) and no dispute exists to weigh against.
